title: CryptoAssetPayments
tagline: Crypto assets (NFTs, Tokens, etc) payments scheduler to allow for wider adoption of crypto assets, closing gaps for better inclusion
description: This project will provide a payment scheduling tool with a smooth and pleasant user experience for easy and mass adoption. Many people are still reticent in purchasing crypto assest due to the inaccessibility economically speaking (some NFTs are pricey) or lack of understanding on how to go about and purchase/own a crypto (blockchain based) asset such as an NFT. Many of the traditional or commercial tools do not offer payment plans to facilitate the obtainment of these assets, we aim to change that with our tool!
how_its_made:
The project uses Superfluid, Ether.js, Gelato Keepers for managing the scheduled payments and of course Solidity smart contract in the backend. 

Potential tools to add which due to lack of time we could not incorporate to the tool (at this time). Event detection for payment made and reminder using (Abacus or Moralis) and AWS SES to also send an email (offchain solution unfortunately for sending emails).
